$comment: Machine-readable project state. The human-readable companion is MEMORY.md; keep the two in agreement. Validated by scripts/check-memory-freshness.sh in CI.
next_task: Build the Next.js dashboard and marketing site (P4.1, P4.6), then verify against live Postgres/Redis.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.evidence: Workspace, schema migrations, typed config, CI, health endpoints, ADRs 001-004.

phases.name: Auth, keys, orgs
phases.evidence: Gateway side complete: argon2id auth, sessions, API key CRUD with LRU+Redis cache, audit log, org/member management. Dashboard UI outstanding.

phases.name: Core gateway
phases.evidence: Nine provider adapters, full pipeline with rate limiting, budgets, BYOK, shared key pool, usage worker, metrics. 622 unit tests.

phases.name: Optimization engine
phases.evidence: Classifier 98% on 100 labelled fixtures, router with conservative defaults, exact + semantic cache, compressor, circuit breakers, savings attribution.

phases.name: Dashboards, billing, launch prep
phases.evidence: Stripe webhook verification, invoice assembly, budget alerts, admin console, savings CSV export complete.

phases.name: Launch + provider expansion
phases.evidence: All five expansion providers implemented and tested. Classifier v2 trained via a real dump/fit pipeline. Status page endpoint live.

phases.name: Enterprise readiness
phases.evidence: Offline license validation with grace period, SCIM 2.0 shapes, SSO assertion validation with replay detection, per-tenant HKDF keys, region pinning, admin TOTP.

phases.name: Scale + moat
phases.evidence: UCB1 outcome bandit with a replay test showing it beats static routing.

blockers.summary: Docker Desktop was not running on the build machine, so nothing has been verified against live Postgres, Redis, or Qdrant.
blockers.impact: Integration tests are written but unexecuted locally. CI runs them against service containers.
blockers.workaround: The gateway compiles and unit-tests with no external service. Set AEGIS_TEST_DATABASE_URL to run the integration suite.

launch_blockers.summary: Seed pricing in metering/pricing.rs was written from memory, not fetched from provider price sheets.
launch_blockers.impact: Every savings figure and invoice line depends on these numbers being right.
launch_blockers.action: Follow docs/runbooks/pricing-update.md and confirm all 28 rows before billing any customer.
